title: Signup dual-role attach fails: service client signed in as user

requirements.expectation: A signed-in motorist completes pro signup; profiles.role = repair_pro and a repair_pro_profiles row exists.
requirements.verification: Route test for the attach path; live attempt on a test account.
evidence: code: 'src/app/api/auth/signup/__tests__/route.test.ts' attach test passes (200, profiles.role=repair_pro, repair_pro_profiles row); failed with 500 before the fix.
live: QA validated (reported 2026-10-25) after merge to dev in PR #46 (8b98687); test environment and accounts not recorded here. Signed-in motorist completed pro attach.

requirements.expectation: The createServiceSupabase() client in the signup route never calls signInWithPassword.
requirements.verification: Test assertion on the service client's auth calls; grep of the route.
evidence: code: grep shows signInWithPassword only on passwordClient()/sessionClient in route.ts; 'src/app/api/auth/signup/__tests__/route.test.ts' asserts the service client's signInWithPassword is never called in all three success paths.

requirements.expectation: The motorist_profiles row is kept after a pro attach.
requirements.verification: Route test asserts no motorist_profiles delete; live DB check.
evidence: code: 'src/app/api/auth/signup/__tests__/route.test.ts' asserts motorist_profiles row unchanged after attach.
live: QA validated (reported 2026-10-25) after merge to dev in PR #46 (8b98687); test environment and accounts not recorded here. Motorist side kept after attach.

requirements.expectation: Wrong password on attach returns 401 password_required and writes nothing.
evidence: code: 'src/app/api/auth/signup/__tests__/route.test.ts' wrong-password attach returns 401 password_required with no upserts and profiles.role still motorist.

requirements.expectation: New-account signup keeps the same status, body shape and returned session.
evidence: code: 'src/app/api/auth/signup/__tests__/route.test.ts' new-account test returns 200 with createdNew, role, accountType and session tokens; createUser path unchanged.

requirements.expectation: Migration 077 grants, policies and guard triggers are unchanged by this fix and still in force on the deployed database.
requirements.verification: Diff shows no migration changes; run scripts/verify/client-write-lockdown.sql only in a disposable local database (never Supabase: it creates tables and regrants); run the read-only scripts/verify/client-write-lockdown-hosted.sql on the deployed database and expect every row ok = true.
evidence: code: diff touches no files under supabase/migrations or scripts/verify.

code: client-write-lockdown.sql passed in a disposable local PostgreSQL 16 (2026-10-25). client-write-lockdown-hosted.sql returned 48/48 ok on a clean local 077 apply and flagged each injected drift (disabled guard trigger, recreated profiles_update_own policy, column UPDATE grant, blanket regrant).
live: client-write-lockdown-hosted.sql not run on the deployed database.

requirements.expectation: A signup_events success row is written after a successful signup.
requirements.verification: Live DB check after a test signup.
evidence: code: 'src/app/api/auth/signup/__tests__/route.test.ts' records one success signup_events row per success path under the RLS-modelling fake (zero before the fix for new accounts).

requirements.expectation: Full test suite, typecheck and lint pass with no new lint warnings against the baseline.
requirements.verification: Run the commands and compare lint output with the dev baseline.
evidence: code: vitest 193 files / 1801 tests pass; tsc --noEmit exit 0; eslint 0 errors, 148 pre-existing warnings, 0 in changed files.
